option-b.rationale: Natural suffering can create moral opportunities, but that fact alone does not justify their scale or cost to victims.

option-a.rationale: The mechanism of repeated choice shaping character is intelligible, yet the claim that serious natural evils are needed at their observed severity is not demonstrated.
